tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Cisco and NVIDIA launch USFP, a 400G pluggable for 12.8T AI network capacity. Reported by Cisco Blogs: the technology expands the path to AI connectivity.
Reported by MeriTalk: Barrett introduces an AI oversight office in the White House to manage emerging tech risks.
China and the U.S. adopt divergent artificial intelligence governance models, one centralized control and one voluntary industry self-regulation. Reported by 美国之音: both nations say they want to regulate superintelligence.
USA Today and 19 papers sue OpenAI over artificial intelligence training using copyrighted news, seeking 250M and model destruction. Reported by Law Commentary: FIFA wants an antitrust lawsuit dismissed after lawyers were sanctioned over suspected AI-generated citations.
Brandon Thomas builds Office-like applications with Claude AI. Reported by Yahoo Tech: his projects remain in development.
Free every hour.
